_note: 1.10.2 (FP11, owner-approved planning/DRAFT_batch_fp7_fp11.md Batch 3): why an NPC who seeks {{user}} out (FP1 NPC initiative) does so today. Generic templates per Tension category (data/tension.json npcs; 'social' when a character has none), filled from the NPC's own data: {place} = one of their haunts (plus common student spots from 'places' for every category but authority), {club} = their club, {thing} = something they love or like (data/gift_prefs.json), {event} = today's or tomorrow's calendar event. A template whose placeholder has no value for that NPC is skipped. The engine never repeats a template + filling for the same NPC within its last 20 uses. 'strained' replaces the category at Tension 70+. Written by the maintainer; not canon for any one character.

favours._note: 1.49.0 (audit/AUDIT_2026-10-03_4_batch_fitur.md batch 1, audit 4.6): some days an NPC's reason for seeking {{user}} out is a favour. Chance per initiative day 'rate', at most 'per_week' offered a week, never at Tension 70+ (strained) and never while that NPC already has an open favour. {thing} (something they love or like, data/gift_prefs.json) becomes the favour Commitment's Item; {place} (their haunts and common spots) is where to be with them. Due within 'due_days'. Kept (removed before overdue): a help deed (bond XP with time together, Trust +2 inside the weekly cap). Left overdue: Tension +ignored_tension once. Generic, written by the maintainer; not canon for any one character.
